text: It's noon. Your whole workday is over.
Spoiler: you still do it every night.
Modern Kalahari foragers found food in a few hours a day. Chores came extra.
So you nap. Fix a spear. Gossip.
By evening, the fire comes out.
By day they argued about food, land, drama.
By night, eighty-one percent of long chats were stories.
Your group chat is basically a campfire.
Not cavemen. But maybe boredom built culture.
What would you do after lunch?
